correctness.rationale: Correct for q>=2, n>=1 in the exactly-one-symbol tandem-duplication model. Duplication preserves the run-root and raises one run-excess coordinate; a common output of different parents forces one legal unit transfer. Any clique of size s>=3 in the fixed nonnegative integer-composition layer is either b+e_i or c-e_i, uniquely by coordinatewise extrema; only the lower form has one common output. Stars-and-bars over q(q-1)^{r-1} roots gives K_up=q sum_{r=s}^n (q-1)^{r-1} binom(r,s)binom(n-2,r-1) and K_low=q sum_{r=s}^n (q-1)^{r-1}binom(r,s)binom(n-s,r-1). Binomial differentiation yields the triple closed form and q/(q+1) limit; max clique n-1 for n>=3 vs parent-set bound floor((n+1)/2). Direct letter-level independent q-ary enumeration reproduced (q,n,K_up,K_low)=(2,5,14,2),(2,6,64,14),(3,4,12,0). The infinite conclusion is proved by the graph/composition lemma, not these checks.
